name: forge
description: Agent-engineering workflow skills for Claude Code, Codex, and opencode — twenty-three fg-* skills: the four-stage loop (fg-ask → fg-run → fg-learn → fg-done) plus outside-the-loop utilities, including fg-security (vendored security audit) and fg-debug (vendored diagnosis only: active failures return to fg-run; independent diagnoses route by size, durable eval, and all-exit safe cleanup). fg-rules reviews evidence-backed project rules before writing, stores adopted changes in top-level .forge/rules/, preserves manual edits, and connects rules to ordinary coding through existing project instructions; fg-map describes current code, while rules guide future work. Connection verification is distinct from observed loading and does not guarantee compliance.

interface.shortDescription: Plan, execute, learn, and seal agent work
interface.longDescription: A shared Claude Code and Codex workflow for turning one task into a reviewed plan, verified execution, retained learning, and a sealed result.
defaultPrompt: Start a new task with Forge.
